content: Custom connectors (remote MCP by URL) are available on Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise; Free plan is limited to ONE custom connector. On Team/Enterprise only an Owner can add one for the org. Install link that prefills the Add custom connector dialog: https://claude.ai/customize/connectors?modal=add-custom-connector&connectorName=NAME&connectorUrl=ENCODED_URL (user must still review and confirm). Custom connectors get NO file transfers (Claude sends no files and strips files from tool results), no Suggested Connectors, cannot allowlist external links. Tool result cap ~150,000 chars on claude.ai/Desktop, 25,000 tokens on Claude Code; 240s tool timeout. Sources: support.claude.com 11175166, claude.com/docs/connectors/custom/add-unlisted, building/directory-vs-custom, building/index, building/files; fetched 2026-11-27.
